sourceRecords.title: Wales Grants Section 36 Consent to Llyr Floating Wind Project
sourceRecords.sourceText: offshoreWIND.biz reported that Welsh ministers granted Section 36 consent to the Llyr Wind Farm, a floating wind test and demonstration project in the Celtic Sea off Pembrokeshire. The record states that Llyr consists of two 100 MW wind farms and is planned around 40 km offshore in water depths averaging 60-70 metres.

sourceRecords.title: Encomara Prepares First Squid Floating Wind Connection System for Inshore Trials in Scotland
sourceRecords.sourceText: offshoreWIND.biz reported that Encomara was preparing inshore trials at Ardersier for its first Squid floating wind connection system. The article states that the 40-tonne system supports mooring lines, power cables, and subsea connectors above the seabed so they can be pre-installed before a floating turbine arrives.

sourceRecords.title: ABS Issues Product Design Assessment to Encomara for Squid FOWT Quick Connect System
sourceRecords.sourceText: ABS stated that it issued a product design assessment to Encomara for the Squid system, a mooring and electrical cable protection technology for floating offshore wind turbines. ABS said it completed a detailed review against class and industry requirements for floating offshore wind applications.

sourceRecords.title: Trump administration latest buyback of offshore wind leases brings total to nearly 4 billion dollars
sourceRecords.sourceText: Associated Press reported that the US administration reached a 1.2 billion dollar settlement with RWE U.S. Offshore to terminate offshore wind projects off New York, California, and Louisiana. The report states that RWE would end its US offshore wind involvement under the settlement.

sourceRecords.title: BW Ideol and NGE join forces in the Mediterranean
sourceRecords.sourceText: BW Ideol announced an equal partnership with NGE on the Fos3F floating foundation factory project in Fos-sur-Mer. The announcement states that the planned serial fabrication line is sized for about 30 floaters per year, equivalent to around 500 MW of annual floating wind capacity.

sourceRecords.title: Experimental Floating Axis Wind Turbine installed in a bay of Iki City, Nagasaki
sourceRecords.sourceText: Sumitomo Heavy Industries announced that the FAWT Consortium installed an experimental Floating Axis Wind Turbine in a bay of Iki City, Nagasaki Prefecture. The announcement states that the offshore demonstration starts in July 2026 and is intended to advance a low-cost domestic offshore wind power generation system.
